name: Is It A Scam?
tagline: Look it up before you pay.
description: A free, plain-language library of scams, each with a threat scorecard, the red flags that give it away, and exactly what to do if it has already happened to you.
disclaimerShort: Scores are our editorial assessment, not official statistics. Illustrative cases are composites written to show how a scam runs, not reports of specific incidents.

categories.name: Banking & Payments
categories.blurb: Attacks on your accounts, cards and payment channels.

categories.name: Investment & Crypto
categories.blurb: Fake returns, fake platforms and schemes that run on new deposits.

categories.name: Identity & Account Takeover
categories.blurb: Someone becoming you, on your phone, your accounts or your credit record.

categories.name: Shopping & Marketplace
categories.blurb: Stores, listings and deliveries that take payment and give nothing.

categories.name: Jobs, Loans & Income
categories.blurb: Scams aimed at people who need work or money right now.

categories.name: Romance & Social
categories.blurb: Relationships and intimacy manufactured to extract money.

categories.name: Government & Utilities
categories.blurb: Impersonation of SASSA, SARS, municipalities and Eskom.

categories.name: Property & Rentals
categories.blurb: The largest payments most people ever make, and who is watching them.

categories.name: Charity & Emergencies
categories.blurb: Generosity and panic, turned into a payment channel.

categories.name: Tech Support & Devices
categories.blurb: Fake technicians, remote access and manufactured alarm.

scoreDimensions.name: Financial impact
scoreDimensions.blurb: How much a typical victim loses.

scoreDimensions.name: Believability

scoreDimensions.name: Prevalence
